Duke Barradin asks you to break the Siege of Piken Square by killing the [[Charr Captain]] and the rest.  

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Destroy the Charr forces besieging Piken Square.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Air Staff]]
** [[Energy]] +4
** [[Lightning Dmg]]: 4-7 (Requires 3 [[Air Magic]])
** Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 10%)
** [[Armor penetration]] +10% (Chance: 10%)
** Two-handed
* [[Furious]] [[War Hammer]]
** [[Blunt Dmg]]: 13-20 (Requires 3 [[Hammer Mastery]])
** Double [[adrenaline]] gain (Chance: 10%)<sup>1</sup>
** Armor penetration +5% (Chance: 10%)
** Two-handed
#Can be [[salvage]]d

==Walkthrough==
The Charr captain is just outside Piken Square, in an open area immediately southwest. Be aware that he has a lot of Charr with him, so it's probably wisest to kill them piecemeal, saving the Captain for last. After killing him, report back to Duke Barradin.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Duke Barradin
:''"Ah, good, it's you. You've earned my trust and my respect, and now I must ask for your assistance once again. As you can see, the Charr have us pinned down. Our only chance is to take out the '''Charr captain''' and break the siege, then take the fight to them. While I ready the troops, I need you to assassinate the Charr captain, then report back to me as soon as possible. Good luck."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = I'm counting on you to break the siege. Take out the '''Charr captain''' and report back to me. I'll ready the troops for the coming offensive.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Duke Barradin
:''"By breaking the siege, you have helped turn the tide in our favor. Thanks to your efforts, Piken Square is secure. We'll establish a base here and launch raids deep into enemy territory. The Charr will be sorry they ever laid eyes on the Great Wall."''
